name: Höxter (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Höxter (a white gate building on red).
history: Municipal flag of Höxter; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Höxter arms — white gate building on red
